question: A motorboat travelling at some speed can cover 24 km upstream and 40 km downstream in 17 hours. At the same speed it can travel 32 km downstream and 12 km upstream in 10 hours. The speed of the stream is:
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Let downstream speed = D and upstream speed = U.

We have: 24/U + 40/D = 17 and 12/U + 32/D = 10.

Double the 2nd equation and subtract the 1st: 24/D = 3 ⇒ D = 8 km/h.

Substitute D = 8 in 1st equation: 24/U + 5 = 17 ⇒ U = 2 km/h.

Speed of stream = (D − U) ÷ 2 = (8 − 2) ÷ 2 = 3 km/h.

**∴ The correct answer is 3 km/h.**
